fusions.name: Barbed Eddy
fusions.desc: Twists a hooked eddy 4 tiles long ahead of you for 4 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward, dealing 10 damage and stunning each for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagged Silt
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A barbed strike with a wet edge deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Reel In
fusions.desc: Hooks up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles and pulls them onto you for 5 seconds. A current of water fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Caught Fast
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying one of your conditions, your damage rises by 10%.
